promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium stone mannequin design reference for a 3D model on a refined vagus-stimulation earbud website.
Primary request: Create a single exceptionally refined, photorealistic sculpture portrait: an adult gender-neutral human mannequin bust carved from warm ivory limestone/alabaster, with the vagus nerve and related neural pathways elegantly highlighted. Gallery-quality contemporary sculpture meets high-end industrial design. Believable natural adult proportions, calm composed face, gently closed sculpted eyes, subtle facial asymmetry, bald smooth head, no hair, no eyebrows, no beard. Beautiful anatomically formed ears with crisp helix, antihelix, tragus, ear canal opening and concha/cymba details suitable for fitting small earbuds later.
Scene/backdrop: seamless pale cool grey studio background matching #f5f5f7, delicate contact shadow, no other objects.
Composition/framing: a single bust at a gentle three-quarter angle, near ear fully visible, head upright, neutral straight neck, relaxed shoulders, whole crown and both shoulder ends visible, sculpture ends in a clean horizontal cut below the clavicles across the upper chest. Eye-level long lens, minimal perspective distortion, centered, portrait 4:5 framing, generous breathing room. Subject fills most of image, tack sharp ear geometry and silhouette.
Materials: subtly warm off-white fine-grained stone, silky honed matte finish, extremely restrained delicate mineral veining, realistic microtexture. Substantial carved stone, not plastic or skin. A continuous smooth skull surface; no sliced-open head, no removable lid, no mechanical seams.
Neural design: precise fine champagne-gold inlaid lines with restrained warm amber light, clean and intentional like museum scientific art, never random cracks. Highlight a small delicate cluster within the visible ear's cymba/concha; route its fine auricular branch behind and inward from the ear toward the skull base/brainstem. Show a slender main vagal pathway descending from skull base along each anterolateral side of the neck, subtly branching toward the upper chest; paths follow anatomy and do not form a central spine. In a localized softly translucent stone region at the side/back of the cranium, reveal an understated schematic brainstem and a few related ascending neural connections in muted champagne and faint violet. Keep the exterior sculptural silhouette intact. Central connections are a subordinate schematic overlay distinct from the vagus nerve. Most of the head and face remains solid beautiful stone. Very controlled emissive intensity, no large glow bloom. No nerves across the eyes, lips or forehead, no whole-brain lightning tree, no glowing eyeballs.
Lighting/mood: large soft studio key, gentle fill, delicate rim light, physically plausible soft shadows; quiet, professional, premium, refined, editorial product-design quality. Cohesive with champagne metal and off-white luxury audio products.
Constraints: absolutely no earbuds attached, no jewelry, no wires, no clothes, no text, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no border, no extra busts, no clinical flesh or gore. This is an illustrative neural visualization on a sculptural mannequin, not a medical chart. Produce a polished usable 3D-art reference, not a website mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Edit target: the supplied stone mannequin image.
Preserve the exact sculpture identity, face, eyes, ears, proportions, stone material, camera, framing, lighting and background. Change only the neural overlay.
Make the neural visualization more restrained and anatomically grounded. Remove the decorative branching over the cheek, across the clavicles, out onto the shoulders and over the chest. Instead show two slender main vagal trunks descending the anterolateral neck from the skull base, continuing into the center of the upper thorax with only a few fine short branches. Keep the near ear's small concha/cymba highlight and its fine auricular connection, but route that connection BACK behind the ear and inward toward the skull base, not forward across the temple. Move the stylized brainstem connection backward and downward, behind the ear and near the base of the skull; it must not be beside the eye or in the temple. A tiny localized translucent stone overlay may reveal it. Keep a few subdued ascending central neural connections inside the posterior cranium, with whisper-soft muted violet accents; they are schematic and visually subordinate. No literal cerebellum shape sitting in the temple. Fine champagne inlay with low amber emissive glow, delicate elegant lines, no oversized luminous dots. Preserve an intact smooth sculptural silhouette and keep most stone opaque. No labels, no new objects, no earbuds, no text. Premium quiet museum sculpture reference.

promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Edit target: supplied stone sculpture.
Revise it into a SIMPLER, more MASCULINE, premium stone mannequin shown from the NECK UP ONLY.
Composition: a single head with neck, ending in a clean flat cut at the bottom of the neck. Absolutely no shoulders, no collarbones, no chest, no torso, no pedestal. Entire crown, both ears and neck base visible with comfortable margins. Neutral head position: facing directly forward, head centered and upright over the neck, no tilt, no rotation, no chin lift or downward nod. Level eyes and ears. Eye-level straight-on camera with a long portrait lens, portrait composition.
Form: adult masculine facial structure, broader jaw and chin, defined but restrained brow ridge, slightly broader neck, calm neutral closed mouth, simply sculpted closed eyes. Hairless head, no beard. Refined natural human proportions, not a bodybuilder or caricature. Retain anatomically legible ear contours and concha cavities so earbuds can fit them later.
Simplify: reduce surface and facial detail substantially. Smooth matte ivory stone with very subtle fine grain; virtually no visible mineral veins, cracks or mottling. Broad elegant sculpted facial planes, no skin pores, no eyelashes, no engraved eyebrows, no wrinkles. Keep the stone tactile and expensive, not plastic.
Neural highlights: change ALL neural highlights to PURPLE AND PINK. Delicate soft pink around the concha of each ear, merging into slender lilac/violet pathways at the skull base and down the lateral neck. Show only a small number of clean, fine pathways, with at most two or three short related neural branches near each side/back of the head. Very sparse, restrained and readable. No dense network, no branching tree, no random fine filaments, no glow dots, no visible brain or anatomical organs. Treat the lines as elegant shallow inlays with gentle controlled illumination. Maintain intact opaque stone form; no glass skull or cutaway. No gold, amber or yellow.
Lighting and background: pale cool grey seamless studio background matching #f5f5f7, soft diffuse studio key and fill, gentle sculptural shadows, crisp silhouette, sharp ears, professional premium editorial render. No text, labels, logo, jewelry, earbuds, wires or other objects.

Preserve the exact masculine facial identity, jaw and brow, neutral upright front-facing head, closed eyes, both complete ears, pink and purple simple neural lines, ivory color, cool pale grey background, camera and soft lighting. Neural lines terminate neatly at the new neck cut. Smooth the very fine surface grain slightly for a more restrained honed stone finish. No other design changes. No shoulders, no clavicles, no torso, no text.

Fine honed matte stone, restrained soft pink merging into violet glow, cool pale grey #f5f5f7 seamless background, gentle even studio light, sharp detail through all four views, anatomically complete unobstructed ears.
